title: Execution Engine
headline: Building a query execution engine
tagline: From evaluating one expression against one row to a planner that reads statistics and compiles a query into bytecode you can pause, save, and resume.

parts.title: Expressions
parts.desc: Rows, values, and evaluating a tree

parts.title: Iterators
parts.desc: Operators that pull one row at a time

parts.title: Joins
parts.desc: Nested loops, hash tables, and merging

parts.title: Aggregation & sorting
parts.desc: Grouping, sorting, and running out of memory

parts.title: Indexes
parts.desc: B+trees and not reading the whole table

parts.title: Statistics & planning
parts.desc: Guessing row counts, picking a plan

parts.title: Bytecode
parts.desc: Compiling plans to a resumable VM

programs.engine: the integrated engine: a SQL REPL over the generated dataset (-vm, -e "SQL", -golden FILE)
programs.lesson01: Part 1 · Expressions: tree walking vs closures, three-valued logic

programs.lesson04: Part 4 · Aggregation & sorting: hash/sort agg, external sort, top-N
programs.lesson05: Part 5 · Indexes: a B+tree growing, scan vs index
